what: The big English title on a sub-page hero pops from 0x to 1x scale letter by letter — starts .6s after opening and lasts .6s, order randomly scattered within .1s, and the curve is a custom curve that overshoots slightly to 1.078 and returns, so the letters pop almost all at once with a ”tok-tok”. With start set, it plays once when entering the screen

options.ease: Curve — CustomEase path or ”0.16,1,0.3,1” · GSAP name
options.start: (optional) ScrollTrigger start — once when visible, or immediately on attach if absent

from.where: shared.js .u-hero__title (English hero title on the About, Careers, News and corporate training subpages) — original _heroHeadline/_motionScale (.6s · delay .6 · stagger amount .1 random)

note: If CustomEase is loaded, the original curve is used as is, if not, back.out(1.4) approximates it
